title: Тартар жарят только идиоты  (Only Idiots Fry Tartare)

segments.t: While prepping at his station, Max complains to Kostya once again that things with Vika are complicated whereas things with Sasha are easy, leaving him unable to decide. Across the kitchen, Chef Barinov lectures Lyova that steak tartare is a raw dish and that only complete idiots would ever fry it.
Да, с Викой сложно, с Сашей просто.
Let's walk back through the scene line by line.
'I just do not know.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'not' before landing on 'I'.
'You see, Kostyan, with Vika...' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'do you understand' before landing on 'Vika'. Kostya answers right away.
Да, с Викой сложно, с Сашей просто.
'Yes, with Vika it is complicated, with Sasha it is simple.' The grammar packs 'yes' and 'just' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'I have heard that already.' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'I', while 'heard' completes the thought.
'I do not know what to do.' The negative particle sits right before the verb meaning 'know' to negate the statement. Kostya answers right away.
'Wait, do you have an idea?' The grammar packs 'what' and 'idea' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Go on, get out of here, Kostyan.' Notice how Russian expresses 'let's' and 'Kostyan' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Steak tartare is a raw dish.' Vika anchors the line on 'tartare', while 'dish' completes the thought. Kostya answers right away.
'You do not fry it.' In Russian, the idea of 'him' flows naturally into 'to fry' without extra filler words.
'Only idiots fry it.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'to fry' before landing on 'idiot'.
'Lyova, am I an idiot?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'Lyova' and finishing on 'idiot'. Kostya answers right away.
'What was that pause for?' The meaning hinges on 'what' working together with 'pause' in spoken Russian.
'No, Chef.' Chef Viktor brings out the contrast between 'there is no' and 'chef' in a few short words. Let's hear the full exchange one more time at natural speed.
Да, с Викой сложно, с Сашей просто.
When you watch Scene 3 of Episode 5, listen out for the exchange around only idiots fry tartare — you will recognize every Russian phrase right away. See you in the next scene.
